linganore-winecellars-mount-airy.known_for: Linganore is Maryland's largest winery and has produced award-winning Maryland wines across three generations.
linganore-winecellars-mount-airy.hours_text: Mon–Thurs 10am–5pm, Fri 10am–8pm, Sat 10am–8pm, Sun 12pm–6pm. Closed: New Year's Day, Easter, Thanksgiving, Christmas. Christmas Eve 10am–3pm, New Year's Eve 10am–3pm, July 4th 10am–5pm.
linganore-winecellars-mount-airy.notable: Free winery tours run at noon and 4pm on Saturday and Sunday. Red Shedman Brewery sits next to the tasting room, and seasonal weekends bring food trucks and music.
linganore-winecellars-mount-airy.name: Linganore Winecellars

ayse-meze-lounge-frederick.known_for: Ayse serves Mediterranean and Neapolitan Italian food, including pizza, pasta, meze, and wood-fired seafood.
ayse-meze-lounge-frederick.hours_text: Monday CLOSED; Tuesday - Thursday 11:30am - 8:30pm; Friday 11:30am - 9:00pm; Saturday 4pm - 9:00pm; Sunday 11:30am - 8:30pm
ayse-meze-lounge-frederick.notable: The private dining room holds up to 55 guests. Sunday brunch runs from 11:30am to 2pm, while lunch express service runs Tuesday through Friday from 11:30am to 3:30pm.
ayse-meze-lounge-frederick.name: Ayse Meze Lounge

magoos-frederick.known_for: Magoo's is a traditional downtown Irish pub serving Irish standards and pints.
specials: Traditional Irish Set 1st, 3rd, and 5th Thursdays each month
magoos-frederick.hours_text: Sunday: 11:00 AM-8:00 PM, Monday: 11:00 AM-9:00 PM, Tuesday: 11:00 AM-9:00 PM, Wednesday: 11:00 AM-9:00 PM, Thursday: 11:00 AM-10:00 PM, Friday: 11:00 AM-11:00 PM, Saturday: 11:00 AM-11:00 PM
magoos-frederick.notable: The Celtic Cave and Bridal Suite provide space to get ready for private events. The pub offers dine-in and takeout and also organizes trips to Ireland and Scotland.
magoos-frederick.name: Magoo's Pub & Eatery

acacia-house-frederick.known_for: Fire&Oak serves wood-grilled dishes and comfort food alongside cocktails made with fresh ingredients.
acacia-house-frederick.hours_text: Sunday–Thursday 11:00 AM–11:00 PM, Friday–Saturday 11:00 AM–1:00 AM. Brunch (Saturday & Sunday only) 10:00 AM–2:00 PM.
acacia-house-frederick.notable: The restaurant is in the former Firestone's space in downtown Frederick.
acacia-house-frederick.name: Fire&Oak Culinary Tavern

monocacy-brewing-frederick.known_for: Monocacy beer is brewed and packaged in Frederick.
monocacy-brewing-frederick.hours_text: Monday: 3–9PM, Tuesday: 3–9PM, Wednesday: 3–10PM, Thursday: 3–10PM, Friday: 12–10PM, Saturday: 12–10PM, Sunday: 12–8PM
monocacy-brewing-frederick.notable: The brewery and tasting room are open to the public. Online gift cards and private-event bookings are available.
monocacy-brewing-frederick.name: Monocacy Brewing Company

attaboy-beer-frederick.known_for: Attaboy is an independent Frederick brewery making hazy and West Coast IPAs, pilsners, pale ales, lagers, Belgian styles, seltzers, and hard cider.
attaboy-beer-frederick.notable: The garage and beer garden are dog-friendly, and food trucks visit daily. Seating is casual and first-come, with no reservation required.
attaboy-beer-frederick.name: Attaboy Beer

rockwell-brewery-frederick.known_for: Rockwell brews award-winning beer on site and serves pub food from its own kitchen, with live music on weekends.
rockwell-brewery-frederick.happy_hour: Monday to Friday 3:00–6:00pm: pitchers & special pricing on drinks
specials: Friday 5/31: Songwriter Original Music Series & Open Mic 1pm
Recurring: Salsa Night Dance Party (5/30, 6/26, 7/25, 8/29 at 8pm)
Recurring: Latin Music DJ Dance Party (6/25, 7/30, 8/27 at 7:30pm, no cover charge)
rockwell-brewery-frederick.hours_text: Mon–Thurs 3pm–9pmish, Fri noon–10:30pmish, Sat noon–10:30pmish, Sun noon–8pmish
rockwell-brewery-frederick.notable: Leashed, well-behaved dogs are welcome outdoors, and private-event space is available. The taproom has games for families and offers gluten-reduced beer.
rockwell-brewery-frederick.name: Rockwell Brewery

milkhouse-brewery-mt-airy.known_for: Milkhouse brews classic beer styles with Maryland hops at Stillpoint Farm, which also has a taproom and local mercantile.
milkhouse-brewery-mt-airy.happy_hour: Friday Happy Hour: 3-5pm, $1 off Pints; Thursday: $5 Pours All Night
milkhouse-brewery-mt-airy.hours_text: Taproom Hours: Thursday 5-8pm, Friday 3-8pm, Saturday 1-8pm, Sunday 1-6pm. Mercantile Hours: Saturday 2-7pm, Sunday 2-6pm
milkhouse-brewery-mt-airy.notable: Live music runs every Saturday, and Paws and Pints events welcome dogs. The on-site mercantile carries local food and goods, while the event calendar includes yoga, stargazing, and stitch-and-sip gatherings.
milkhouse-brewery-mt-airy.name: Milkhouse Brewery

dublin-roasters-frederick.known_for: Dublin Roasters uses air roasting for small batches of organic and fair-trade beans sourced from family coffee farms.
dublin-roasters-frederick.hours_text: Mon – Fri: 7 AM – 3 PM, Sat – Sun: 8 AM – 3 PM
dublin-roasters-frederick.notable: The shop displays work by local artists and welcomes dogs. Meeting rooms hold one to 15 people, and the space hosts book clubs and community groups.
dublin-roasters-frederick.name: Dublin Roasters Coffee

frederick-coffee-company-frederick.known_for: Frederick Coffee Co. has served espresso drinks, breakfast sandwiches, and house-made soups since 1991.
frederick-coffee-company-frederick.notable: The shop is in Everedy Square and Shab Row in downtown Frederick, with rotating work by local artists on its walls.
frederick-coffee-company-frederick.name: Frederick Coffee Co & Cafe

isabellas-taverna-tapas-bar-frederick.known_for: Isabella's serves Spanish tapas and taverna food in downtown Frederick.
isabellas-taverna-tapas-bar-frederick.notable: Weekend brunch runs from 8am to 3pm on Saturday and Sunday. Online ordering is available.
isabellas-taverna-tapas-bar-frederick.name: Isabella's Taverna & Tapas Bar

bushwaller-irish-pub-frederick.known_for: Bushwaller's is an Irish pub with 18 draft options, including Guinness, plus whiskey and Irish-American comfort food.
bushwaller-irish-pub-frederick.notable: The building dates to the 1840s, and Guinness originally installed its 18-tap draft system. The pub draws crowds for St. Patrick's Day and televised soccer or rugby matches.
bushwaller-irish-pub-frederick.name: Bushwaller's

el-rancho-frederick.known_for: Gran Azteca serves Mexican food made with seasonal ingredients from local farmers' markets, with dine-in, patio, and takeout options.
specials: Monday: Fajitas (Steak or Chicken) $20, House Margaritas (Any Flavor) $7
Tuesday: Taco Tuesday $3.99 (Steak, Chicken, Birria, Beef Tongue, Chorizo, Al Pastor, Carnitas, Fish, Shrimp, Barbacoa)
Thursday: Taco Trio $15 (Served with Rice & Beans)
el-rancho-frederick.notable: An outdoor patio is available. The Hernandez del Cid family's restaurant experience spans 22 years.
el-rancho-frederick.name: Gran Azteca Mexican Food Bar & Grill

smoketown-brewing-brunswick.known_for: Smoketown serves beer and food in a restored Brunswick fire station, with community events and a dog-friendly patio overlooking the railroad bridge.
smoketown-brewing-brunswick.notable: The spacious patio welcomes dogs and overlooks the bridge and passing trains. Upstairs at Smoketown provides an event hall for gatherings.
smoketown-brewing-brunswick.name: Smoketown Brewing

main-cup-middletown.known_for: The Main Cup serves comfort-food standards and globally inspired dishes in a restaurant and bar setting.
specials: Toss It Up Tuesday Salad Special
main-cup-middletown.hours_text: Closes at 8PM (Closed Christmas Day & New Years Day)
main-cup-middletown.name: The Main Cup

the-cozy-creamery-thurmont.known_for: The menu features award-winning broasted chicken and home-style cooking made with fresh, locally sourced ingredients.
specials: 8 pieces of chicken & 2 pint sides $18.99 - Every Wednesday
the-cozy-creamery-thurmont.hours_text: Monday Closed; Tuesday - Friday 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM; Saturday 7:00 AM - 8:00 PM; Sunday 7:00 AM - 2:00 PM
the-cozy-creamery-thurmont.notable: The family-owned restaurant offers catering and takes part in community events.
the-cozy-creamery-thurmont.name: Thurmont Kountry Kitchen

isabellas-taverna-tapas-bar.known_for: Isabella's serves Spanish tapas in downtown Frederick.
isabellas-taverna-tapas-bar.notable: Weekend brunch runs from 8am to 3pm on Saturday and Sunday. Online ordering is available.
isabellas-taverna-tapas-bar.name: Isabella's Taverna & Tapas Bar

wastlers-barber-shop.known_for: Wastler's has provided precision haircuts, classic shaves, and modern grooming services since 1965.
wastlers-barber-shop.notable: The family-owned barbershop opened in 1965 and has served generations of Frederick customers.
wastlers-barber-shop.name: Wastler’s Barber Shop

7th-sister.known_for: 7th Sister serves Mid-Atlantic food, including oysters with blackberry mignonette and a house crab cake seared until golden with whole-grain mustard and herbs.
7th-sister.hours_text: Brunch Sat-Sun: 11am-3pm, Dinner Seating Thu - Sun: 4pm-9pm
7th-sister.notable: The restaurant occupies a historic Frederick mansion, and The Shed & Patio is available for private events.
7th-sister.name: 7th Sister

drewskiithebarber.known_for: The barbershop has provided haircuts and grooming services to generations of customers since 1965.
drewskiithebarber.notable: The barbershop was founded in 1965 and is now at 48 North Market Street.
drewskiithebarber.name: Wastler’s Barber Shop

best-of-business-listings.known_for: The shop sells soda in retro glass bottles, candy popular on TikTok, and local ice cream.
best-of-business-listings.name: North Market Pop Shop

frederick-soups-and-comfort-foods.known_for: The menu centers on soup and comfort food, with weekly changes and daily variation.
frederick-soups-and-comfort-foods.notable: The kitchen makes small batches each day and closes when they sell out. It does not accept phone or advance orders and does not offer delivery.
frederick-soups-and-comfort-foods.name: Frederick Soups and Comfort Foods

manoushe.known_for: Bakehouse makes croissants and other baked goods, including cruffins, scones, and specialty cakes.
manoushe.notable: The storefront bakery is at 69 South Market Street in downtown Frederick.
manoushe.name: Bakehouse

mon-bon-croissant.known_for: Mon Bon is a bakery cafe that specializes in croissants.
mon-bon-croissant.name: Mon Bon Croissant Bakery Cafe

mackies-southern-bbq.known_for: Mackie's serves Texas-style, slow-smoked barbecue, including baby back ribs, pulled pork, and brisket.
mackies-southern-bbq.hours_text: Sunday 11:00 AM - 07:00 PM, Monday Closed, Tuesday–Saturday 11:00 AM - 07:00 PM
mackies-southern-bbq.notable: This family-owned barbecue business operates a food truck in Olney and offers dine-in service and event catering. A portion of every sale supports local schools and first responders.
mackies-southern-bbq.name: Mackie's Barbecue - Catering

the-station-market-and-cafe.known_for: The Station is a farm-to-table vegetarian cafe using local ingredients in its pastries, soups, and other dishes.
the-station-market-and-cafe.hours_text: Mon Closed, Tue Closed, Wed 09:00 am – 04:00 pm, Thu 09:00 am – 04:00 pm, Fri 09:00 am – 05:00 pm, Sat 09:00 am – 05:00 pm, Sun 09:00 am – 04:00 pm
the-station-market-and-cafe.notable: The kitchen opens around 9:30am on operating days, and weekday online orders quote a 20- to 25-minute pickup time. The site hosts a Saturday farmers market and CSA pickup and is available for rentals or catering.
the-station-market-and-cafe.name: The Station Market & Cafe

roros-mexican-grill-and-cantina.known_for: Plaza Mexico serves Mexican standards such as quesadillas, nachos, and churros in a colorful family restaurant.
roros-mexican-grill-and-cantina.happy_hour: Monday–Thursday 3pm–7pm: Traditional Jumbo House Margaritas $9.00, all beer $1 off
roros-mexican-grill-and-cantina.notable: The bar serves beer and margaritas. The kitchen closes 30 minutes before the restaurant.
roros-mexican-grill-and-cantina.name: Plaza Mexico Restaurant

frederick-coffee-co-cafe.known_for: Frederick Coffee Co. has served espresso drinks, breakfast sandwiches, and house-made soups since 1991.
frederick-coffee-co-cafe.notable: The shop occupies a colorful historic building in Everedy Square and Shab Row that once housed a Sinclair gas station and Frederick's first video store. Local art rotates on the walls.
frederick-coffee-co-cafe.name: Frederick Coffee Co & Cafe

midnight-run-brewing.known_for: Midnight Run brews stouts, sours, IPAs, and Belgian ales, with a tap list that changes weekly.
midnight-run-brewing.hours_text: Monday - closed, Tuesday - closed, Wednesday - 5-10p, Thursday - 5-10p, Friday - 4-10p, Saturday - 12-10p, Sunday - 12-8p
midnight-run-brewing.notable: The taproom welcomes dogs and allows outside food. Beer is available to go.
midnight-run-brewing.name: Midnight Run Brewing

sweeties.known_for: Sweeties makes all-natural ice cream in rotating flavors and also sells candy and gifts.
sweeties.hours_text: Between Labor Day & Memorial Day: Monday–Thursday 12–9pm, Friday 12–10pm, Saturday 11am–10:30pm, Sunday 11am–9pm. Other times weather permitting.
sweeties.notable: The Carroll Creek Park shop offers free tastes before purchase and sells candy alongside ice cream. Umbrella tables provide outdoor seating.
sweeties.name: Sweeties

jraymonds-steakhouse.hours_text: Kitchen: 5 p.m. - 9 p.m. Sunday-Thursday, 5 p.m. - 10 p.m. Friday-Saturday
jraymonds-steakhouse.happy_hour: Mon–Fri 4–6pm: Social Hour at the bar
jraymonds-steakhouse.notable: Valet parking is available at the Church Street entrance.
jraymonds-steakhouse.name: Wye Oak Tavern

hoffman-brothers-ice-cream.known_for: Hoffman Brothers makes ice cream in signature flavors such as Honey Graham, Chocolate Love, and Caramel Crunch, with nondairy options available.
hoffman-brothers-ice-cream.name: Hoffman Brothers Ice Cream

tin-corner.known_for: Tin Corner serves slow-simmered pho, sizzling rice plates, and Vietnamese dishes with house-made sauces.
tin-corner.notable: The restaurant is near the north end of Market Street in downtown Frederick, close to several bars and breweries.
tin-corner.name: Tin Corner

cacique-frederick.known_for: Cacique serves Spanish and Latin American dishes, including Chile Relleno, Paella Valencia, and Fajita Trio Deluxe, along with award-winning margaritas and sangria.
cacique-frederick.notable: Cacique opened in 2004 and now has a second location in Hagerstown. The Frederick dining room has a comfortable, relaxed setting.
cacique-frederick.name: Cacique Restaurant
